newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian castor prices fall as rain affects output.
newsitem.headline: Indian castor prices fall as rain affects output.

text.p: Indian castorseed December delivery prices on Tuesday fell to 1,129/1,130 rupees per quintal from 1,132/1,133 on fresh offerings, dealers said.
Reports of the commencement of the third and final round of rain in the producing centres triggered bull liquidation at higher levels, they said.
Trading volume however was low and no trade reported in the maturing September delivery. Groundnut oil slid to 426/427 rupees per 10 kg from 428/430 on sluggish physical demand.
"Imported palm oil is cheaper and nobody is going for groundnut oil at current high levels," one miller said.
